The Project Coordinator IV provides project coordination, operational, and communication support to the Regulatory Science & Communication team. This role works closely with Regulatory Affairs, Regulatory Communications, project leaders, and cross-functional partners to plan and execute team initiatives, maintain schedules and documentation, coordinate stakeholder engagement, and support the timely delivery of regulatory science and communication objectives.

The Project Coordinator IV serves as a central point of coordination for information, meetings, action items, risks, decisions, and deliverables. The role helps establish clear communication pathways, consistent project practices, and organized governance mechanisms across initiatives. Working under limited supervision, the Project Coordinator IV independently manages non-routine assignments, identifies opportunities to improve team processes, and recommends practical solutions that enhance execution, transparency, and stakeholder alignment.

Coordinate projects and programs for the Regulatory Science & Communication team from initiation through completion, including schedules, milestones, dependencies, deliverables, and follow-up activities.
Schedule and coordinate meetings, prepare agendas and materials, capture decisions and action items, and monitor follow-up commitments.
Track project status, timelines, budgets, resources, risks, issues, and dependencies; identify potential delays or gaps and escalate them as appropriate.
Gather, organize, analyze, and summarize information for project updates, leadership reviews, regulatory science activities, communication materials, and other team deliverables.
Coordinate the review, approval, and distribution of regulatory science and communication materials, ensuring that required contributors and reviewers are engaged at the appropriate time.
Monitor shared mailboxes, project trackers, document repositories, and other team systems to promote timely responses, accurate records, and effective information flow.
Support onboarding and training activities related to project processes, tools, systems, and documentation standards.
Coordinate vendors, purchase orders, invoices, contracts, meeting logistics, and travel or expense activities when required.

At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.

This position is exclusively intended for candidates who successfully completed the F5 Summer 2026 Internship Program and have received an invitation to apply for a return role.

Position Summary

This is the full-time conversion role for Data Analyst Interns who have successfully completed their internship in F5's Data Analyst Internship program and have earned their Bachelor's or Master's degree. This position marks your transition from internship to a permanent, full-time role within the F5 Digital organization, allowing you to build on the skills, relationships, and knowledge you've developed during your internship experience.

As a Data Analyst on F5's Enterprise Data Management (EDM) team within the F5 Digital organization, you will continue to support how F5 defines, improves, and validates our critical enterprise data. You'll work alongside analysts and engineers within our Data and Insights team to analyze data issues, support operational needs in current-state systems, and contribute to activities tied to data rebuild/migration efforts. This role offers you the opportunity to deepen your expertise with real-world datasets, improve data quality, and apply what you've learned about how data is managed, structured, and used to support business decisions in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

This position is based in Seattle, WA.

Eligibility & Who Should Apply

This role is exclusively available to:

Current or recent Data Analyst Interns in F5's internship program who have successfully completed their internship
Individuals who have earned or are about to earn their Bachelor's or Master's degree from an accredited college or university in the US (graduating between December 2026 and August 2027)
Those who have demonstrated strong performance, technical aptitude, and cultural fit during their internship

Your Role & Responsibilities

Building on your internship foundation, your typical day may involve:

Taking on increased ownership of EDM Data Quality operations related to customer data (Organizations/Individuals), including investigation of complex issues and conducting ad hoc analysis with greater autonomy
Contributing to the proactive quality management of customer data through profiling and analysis of third-party enrichment sources
Analyzing and validating data involved in Salesforce customer records and Marketo-related requests (as applicable), using spreadsheets, reporting tools, and basic scripting
Managing and analyzing Hardware Asset to Site/Party relationships (e.g., data supporting Renewals and Services motions), including identifying anomalies and leading cleanup efforts

Mentoring new interns or junior team members as you grow in the role
Following data governance, security, and privacy best practices
Performing other related duties assigned

Solid understanding of data concepts (e.g., data quality, databases, schemas)
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail; ability to follow data lineage and identify root causes of data issues
Strong verbal and written communication skills (able to summarize findings for both technical and non-technical audiences)
Ability to learn quickly and comfort tackling complex, cross-system problems with curiosity and initiative
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deliver on deadlines in a collaborative environment
Proficiency with spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets) required; Tableau experience is a plus
Familiarity with SQL, Python, or R for analysis is preferred but not required
Interest in enterprise data concepts (data domains, data quality, governance, master/reference data)
Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
Experience with F5's systems and business processes (gained during internship)

Willingness to remain based in or relocate to Seattle for this full-time role
Valid work authorization in the United States

Seamless Transition: Move from internship to full-time with continuity in your team, projects, and growth trajectory
Professional Development: Continue developing your skills with ongoing training, mentorship, and access to advanced learning opportunities
Meaningful Work: Contribute to real business impact and solve complex enterprise data challenges
Collaborative Culture: Work alongside experienced analysts, engineers, and leaders in an inclusive, innovative environment
Career Growth: Excel in your role and build a long-term career path with F5, including opportunities for advancement and specialization
Inclusive Community: Be part of F5's diverse, people-first culture where individual contributions are valued

Professional development and continuous learning opportunities

About Us

Nova Space Solutions, LLC (NSS) is a joint venture between Wolf Creek Federal Services, Inc. (a wholly-owned subsidiary of Chugach Government Solutions, LLC) and Amentum Technology, Inc. When you join NSS, you also become a part of a proud legacy of supporting missions while sustaining culture.

The federal division of Chugach Alaska Corporation, Chugach Government Solutions, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, has been supporting critical missions as a government contractor for over 25 years. We are proud to have built, and continue to foster, an incredibly talented team spanning across the globe in hundreds of different fields – each team member proud to serve our country with first-class business services, while also making a difference for our Chugach shareholders.

Empowering employees is a part of our core, and that focus is one of the ways we build and foster high-performing teams. We empower our employees through competitive compensation and benefits package, professional growth opportunities, truthful communication, and more!

If you are looking for an opportunity to serve something bigger than yourself; if you want your day job to be one that creates meaningful value; if you are looking for an environment that highly values employees and respects individual differences – then Nova Space Solutions may be the right fit for you!

Position Location

Stennis Space Center, MS

Job Overview

Project Coordinator role is to assist the supervisor with coordinating and assigning project-related tasks, support the development and organization of proposal documents, and help maintain and track engineering service requests. This includes ensuring that estimates, completion dates, and status updates remain accurate and current. The Project Coordinator will serve as the engineering point of contact for work control processes, providing updates on project status, cost tracking, and documentation needs.

Additional responsibilities include supporting project controls with scheduling requirements, monitoring progress against milestones, facilitating communication among engineering team members, and helping ensure alignment with department goals. The Project Coordinator may also assist with maintaining project standards, supporting training initiatives, and providing general administrative and coordination support across engineering activities.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Duties:

Coordinate and track day‑to‑day engineering project activities at NASA Stennis Space Center.
Support development, organization, and assembly of proposal documents and supporting materials.
Maintain and update engineering service requests, ensuring estimates, scope details, and completion dates remain accurate.
Serve as the primary engineering point of contact for work control, providing updates on project status, costs, and documentation requirements.
Monitor project progress and assist with cost tracking, schedule adherence, and milestone reporting.
Support project controls personnel with scheduling inputs, timeline updates, and resource coordination.
Facilitate communication between engineering staff, project managers, and work control teams to ensure alignment on priorities and deliverables.
Assist Engineering Management with coordinating and assigning project‑related tasks.
Maintain project documentation standards and support improvements to workflows and processes.
Track and report on action items, risks, and issues affecting project execution.
Support training initiatives and onboarding related to project management tools or procedures.
Assist with Maximo purchase requests, purchase orders, receiving invoices, and accruals.
Monitor logistics of shipments and deliveries for projects.
Support project management office with change management, including change requests, change orders, RFIs, Transmittals, variance logs, and change notifications.
Participate in project reviews and status meetings.
Support project report development and Data Requirements Deliverables, including weekly PC19 and monthly FA02 Design and FA03 Construction status quads.

Job Requirements

Mandatory:

Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field, OR 6 years of experience in engineering/project management‑related disciplines, OR a combined 3–5 years of relevant education and experience.
Must be a U.S. Citizen to obtain required NASA badge.
Must be able to provide a certified Birth Certificate (with state seal), Passport, or INS Citizenship documents on date of hire.
Must be able to communicate effectively in the English language, both verbal and written.
Must have, and maintain, a valid driver’s license.
Must be able to pass a pre-employment background check and drug screen test.
Clean, neat, and professional personal appearance.
Will ensure quality and completeness of work in a safe and timely manner.
Strong understanding of project coordination and project management principles.
Familiarity with engineering workflows, service request processes, and work control systems.
Ability to track and manage project schedules, milestones, and cost data.
Skilled in organizing and assembling proposal documents and supporting materials.
Proficiency in interpreting estimates, scopes of work, and completion criteria.
Strong communication skills for coordinating between engineering teams, work control, and project controls.
Ability to maintain accurate project documentation and ensure version control.
Experience using project management tools or software (e.g., MS Project, Primavera, or similar).
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Competence in identifying risks, tracking action items, and reporting status updates.
Knowledge of standard administrative practices and documentation procedures.
Ability to support training initiatives related to project systems or workflows.
